products.title: Spider Guard Mastery by Michael Langhi
products.body:
Master the Technical Secrets of an Amazing Spider Guard with Multiple-Time World Champion and Spider Guard Specialist, Michael Langhi!

  • Michael Langhi is multiple time World, Pan, European, and Brazilian National Champion and holds a black belt under the legendary Rubens Charles “Cobrinha”
  • Learn the best and most high percentage spider guard techniques available that will help you add dangerous layers to your guard
  • Pick from multiple sweeps, submissions, and transitions backed with world level instruction and exceptional details


Develop Sophisticated Spider Guard Attacks With One Of The Best Athletes To Use It, Michael Langhi!

Check out a free sample:

 

 

What Will You Learn?


In Spider Guard Mastery, Alliance Coach, Cobrinha Black Belt and Multiple-Time World Champion, Michael Langhi will provide you with world class instruction on his most relied upon and high percentage spider guard techniques and tricks. With genius guidance from Langhi himself, who has already proven his techniques at the highest levels of the sport, attacking with the spider guard using multiple sweeps, submissions, and transitions will become easier than ever!



Langhi will provide expert instruction on intelligent reversals, submissions like the omoplata and the triangle, and even transitions to the back, plus more, all paired with the incredibly powerful utility of the spider guard. He’ll bring the DLR guard, lasso, and the X-guard into the fold as well, to give you even more options and versatility. You'll tangle your opponents with next level controls and funnel them over and over again into bad positions, where you can trap and attack with techniques that have been proven effective at the highest levels of grappling competition!

Snag Submissions From Spider Guard!

 

 


Explore one of the most controlling guards in all of BJJ with one of the best to ever do it! You'll enjoy Langhi’s easy-to-follow instruction and incredibly efficient technique as you work your way through this amazing library of spider guard mastery!

products.title: Spider Guard Tricks by Thamires Aquino
products.body:
Learn tricky spider guard techniques with top GFT black belt competitor Thamires Aquino

  • Aquino is one of the most successful female competitors in BJJ and has claimed gold at multiple high level events including IBJJF, CBJJ, Abu Dhabi Grand Slam, and much more
  • Master Aquino’s brilliant spider guard game using sweeps, submissions, and guard retention tactics that will add dangerous new layers to your guard game and make attacking from the guard easier than ever
  • Use the same techniques that have been used to score and win at high level BJJ competitions


Learn tricky spider guard techniques with top GFT black belt competitor Thamires Aquino

Aquino is one of the most successful female competitors in BJJ and has claimed gold at multiple high level events including IBJJF, CBJJ, Abu Dhabi Grand Slam, and much more

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

With Spider Guard Tricks you'll receive world class instruction from decorated elite level balck belt competitor Thamires Aquino on her championship producing spider guard strategies and tactics. Aquino will provide you with new tools and genius techniques to help you build a truly dangerous spider guard game and make attacking from the bottom easier than ever!

You'll spend the opening parts of the series on guard retention and battling common spider guard passes to keep your spider guard intact. Once you understand how to protect your spider guard you'll move into some brilliant options to reverse so that you can score and get on top with greater ease! From here you'll start transitioning to the x-guard and master more sweeps, back takes, and much more to continue attacking! You'll round out the two part series with some amazing submission options, where you'll use the triangle, omoplata, armbar and more to finish your opponents efficiently and secure the win!

Aquino has put her spider guard to the test at the highest levels of competition and now she's ready to share her innovations with you. This is some of the most technical and detail oriented spider guard mastery ever put on an instructional and you'll be amazed at the effectiveness of the content. Don't miss the opportunity to learn the spider guard from one of the most successful female BJJ competitors of her generation!

﻿From Spider Guard To Armbar

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1:

  • Intro
  • Toreando Defense 
  • Spider Guard Passing Defense When Opponent Breaks The Grip
  • Defending The Guard Pass When There’s No Grip On The Opponent
  • Playing Spider Guard From Closed Guard When Opponent Closes The Elbows 
  • Breaking The Pants Grip And Setting Up The Spider Guard 
  • From Double Under To Spider Guard 
  • The Concept Of Foot Positioning Playing Spider Guard 
  • Recovering The Guard From Toreando Pass 
  • Spider Guard Sweep Pushing The Knee 
  • Balloon Sweep From Spider Guard 
  • From Spider Guard Grabbing The Pants Using Hook To X Guard Sweeping 

Part 2:

  • X Guard Sweep Twisting The Hips When Opponent Posts The Hands 
  • X Guard Sweep Pulling The Arm Between The Legs With A Grip On The Triceps 
  • From Spider Guard To Inverted De La Riva Sweeping 
  • From Spider Guard To X Guard To Back Take 
  • X Guard Sweep Coming Up With Leg Drag 
  • Toe Hold And Straight Foot Lock From X Guard 
  • From Spider Guard With Collar Grip To Triangle 
  • From Spider Guard With Collar Grip To Omoplata 
  • From Spider Guard To Arm Bar 
  • From Modified Spider Guard To Omoplata To Arm Bar

products.title: Shin Spider Domination by Michelle Nicolini
products.body:
Shin Spider Domination by Michelle Nicolini

  • Learn the legendary Nicolini Spider Guard system from one of the greatest female competitors in BJJ history
  • Michelle Nicolini shares her complete shin-on-shin and spider guard game with sweeps, submissions, and transitions
  • Covers the Nicolini Spider Guard, shin on shin seated guard, and overhook X-Guard
  • Includes foot locks, knee bars, calf slicers, and multiple sweep options from each position


What Will You Learn?

Multiple-time world champion Michelle Nicolini reveals her signature spider guard and shin-on-shin system in this comprehensive 3-part instructional. Starting with her unique approach to establishing and controlling spider guard, Michelle walks you through sweeps, triangles, and transitions before diving into her devastating shin on shin seated guard game. The series culminates with her overhook X-Guard system, complete with sweeps and leg lock finishes that have made her one of the most feared guard players in competition.

Technique List

Part 1: Introduction to the Nicolini Spider Guard

  • Introduction
  • Gaining the Nicolini Spider Guard
  • Establishing Control Nicolini Spider Guard
  • Spider Guard Sweep: Option 1
  • Spider Guard Sweep: Option 2
  • Tripod Sweep
  • Triangle

Part 2: Shin on Shin Seated Guard

  • Establishing the Shin on Shin Guard Off a Failed Nicolini Spider Guard / Double Leg Sweep
  • Shin on Shin Dive Under Double Leg Sweep
  • Back Step Defense to Hook Sweep
  • Back Step Defense to Back Take
  • Back Take Variation vs. Strong Base

Part 3: Overhook X-Guard

  • Transitioning From Shin on Shin to X-Guard
  • Kick Back Sweep
  • Collar Pull Sweep
  • Foot Lock
  • Foot Lock Alternative Angle
  • Calf Slicer
  • Knee Bar
  • Toe Hold
  • Toe Hold: Option 1
  • Toe Hold: Option 2

products.title: Winning With The Spider Guard by Kimberly Pruyssers
products.body:
Learn All About The Spider Guard, From Its Basics To Its More Advanced Elements, And Master This Controlling Open Guard That Helps You Slow Down The Fight And Attack Off Your Back

  • Learn how to control and sweep your opponent with ease, all while remaining in complete control of the position.
  • Learn how to transition from spider guard into all kinds of positions so that your opponent can’t defend against all of them.
